Post Date: 2022-05-16T09:53:15Z

Title: Method to disable sequential playback on MediaSource level
Description: I am looking for a way to disable sequential playback of mp3s on `MediaSource` level (of course, the MediaSource in my case is a `ConcatenatingMediaSource`). I know about the method `setPauseAtEndOfMediaItems` on exoplayer level. But this disables sequential playback for ALL media sources used by exoplayer. I would like to disable sequential playback on one `MediaSource` while enable it on another `MediaSource`. Is there something like `MediaSource.setPauseAtEndOfMediaItems` ? Thank you!
